displayName: OCI-PCI-019: PCI-DSS — Third-Party Remote Access to CDE
description:
Detects unauthorized third-party remote access to cardholder data environment

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: pci-dss — third-party remote access to cde

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_pci_019", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%pci%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%dss%') AND "value" > 0
